# Protected existing-signer local iOS16 build

This source packet prepares one local iOS build on the existing public `rungerunge/loyalino-test` repository's standard `macos-26` runner. App hosting remains Railway. It creates no EAS cloud job, account, certificate, profile, paid runner, TestFlight submission or physical verification. Import/default entry modes do not read actual inputs or invoke a provider. Root owns every operation after full source review and independent approval.

The genuine public probe run37385144943, job112016492062, observed macOS26.6.2, Xcode26.6 build17F113, iOSSDK26.5, Node24.20.0, Ruby3.4.10, fastlane2.239.0 and CocoaPods1.17.0. ImageOS is `macos26`, ImageVersion is `20260907.0351.1`. The official image tag is `macos-26-arm64/20260907.0351`, commit `691bdc2593839b6bd2615aaa9718ca646ec3d4a6`. Its release is marked prerelease; the selected standard public runner label is the documented free label. No larger, private, preview-label or paid fallback exists in this workflow. Root's local synthetic gate uses pinned Node22.23.3; actual runner admission checks Node24.20.0 and the full observed tuple again before and after building. PowerShell7.6.5 is separately documented by the immutable official image and checked by actual before/after invocations; the original seven-tool probe did not observe PowerShell.

The source is exactly commit `6aa3fc0fed9ccdd929533632ed1edef2e1f8cde5`, mobile tree `e8d8747bcda1afb1bd942c2df85ef903e661b6f7`, 249 regular tracked files. Backend source remains `a59e987d45d59ae6e6cdc53620c1640495cd4626`. The source manifest comes from exact Git blobs, including original modes, SHA1 framing, lengths and SHA256. Only `buildNumber: '13'` becomes `'16'` in app.config.ts; job.version.buildNumber is also16. The Android version, package lock and other 248 files stay byte-identical. No node_modules, generated native directory, actual .env, Firebase file, private key or previous artifact directory is collected. The committed .env.example is a public placeholder. Source data and the IPA never enter the public repository as plaintext.

Root export

1. Root uses publication.cjs to publish only reviewed public helper/workflow files, preserving every current remote tree entry. Every flat review file, including a protected-ios16.yml copy, must exist under .github/protected-ios16 for bootstrap; an identical YAML is registered separately at .github/workflows/nm-protected-ios16.yml. The workflow must first exist on default main. Immediately before any scoped write or key placement, Root derives current main/ref/files again and verifies the expected reviewed bytes, existing ADMIN identity, public/nonarchived repository, enabled Actions, complete collaborator/writer census, and reviewed workflows. Missing facts do not become true flags.
2. Root creates a new private `protected/<newUUID>` directory and supplies the unapproved template's concrete fresh approval plus build-input.json. Existing owner/certificate/profile reference hashes are protected Root bindings. `referenceSigningProofSha256` is an opaque historical reference value hash, not a claim that it hashes an old proof file. Old signing observations do not establish current validity. Root first makes a genuinely current remote-version read; native16 requires current remote iOS version15 and no unexpected competing build/version.
3. `root-export.cjs --export <UUID>` checks its source/dependency receipt and exact Git files, then performs one fixed current remote-version query and exactly three read-only existing-signer queries: current identity, metadata, then private material. The four EAS24.8-schema reads share one30s deadline, require remote iOS15/store1.0.0 before any MATERIAL read, and request no version mutation/reset. Current owner/project/account/team/bundle, one existing APP_STORE signer, serial/profile UUID, dates and metadata equality must all pass before the material is sealed. There is no credential setup, create/assign action, Apple password/2FA or EAS build mutation. Existing Expo token/session access stays in memory on Root. Child environments exclude diagnostics/proxies and never carry Expo authentication into CI.
4. P12 key possession is checked by signing a random challenge and verifying it with its certificate. SignedCms7.6.5 verifies profile cryptographic signature, exact serial/UUID, unexpired certificate/profile, certificate inclusion, team/bundle, App Store-like no-device profile, production push and entitlements. These are cryptographic/stored-reference checks, not current Apple revocation, issuer-chain or live account acceptance claims. The same original SignedCms algorithm is reused honestly; no invented C# continuation is claimed. Mutable strings cannot be securely erased by JavaScript; buffers/derived keys are cleared, nothing is printed, and process lifetime is bounded.
5. AES256-GCM binds the whole source/signer payload to the operation, reviewed workflow commit, source receipt, native/backend source and numeric16. HKDF separates INPUT, CLAIM and OUTPUT. Root creates a fresh32-byte key and random12-byte nonce per envelope. `key.bin`, input-UUID.nmae and all operation files remain in the private Root directory. The key is never a command-line argument or public asset.

One CI operation

Root creates a unique cipher-only prerelease tag `nm-ios16-<UUID>` at the exact reviewed workflow commit, uploads only input-UUID.nmae, and rechecks tag to commit. Root creates a unique `nm-ios16-<UUID>` environment with exactly that tag policy and no other secrets. The only placed secret is the per-run AES key, sent to the existing GitHub CLI on stdin. No broad EXPO_TOKEN is placed in the repository. `root-github.cjs` provides the fixed environment, secret, dispatch and deletion operations; Root's genuine metadata/source/tag/policy verifiers are mandatory ports. Root dispatches the tag, not mutable main, once. It records acknowledgement separately from a completed run.

The public workflow checks repository, actor, manual event, first run attempt and exact tag/commit before Node. The runner decrypts only after verifying all helper bytes. A successful exclusive encrypted claim-UUID.nmae upload spends the shared per-operation fence before building. A second job/run cannot replay that operation even if it starts within approval lifetime. No automatic retry, redating, overwrite, rerun attempt or fallback exists. A failed or expired operation remains spent/history and requires independently reviewed new authority.

The approval is exactly600s and applies at Root export, dispatch, runner admission and genuine plugin start. Queue/installation delay crossing its expiry refuses before the build. Once admitted and started, a separate real2h build deadline and3min return deadline apply; audits never re-authorize an expired approval. The140min GitHub job bound does not promise success or extend either deadline. Runtime npm dependencies are locked, installed with scripts disabled, into an isolated private directory. The exact plugin24.8.0 accepts `EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_PLUGIN_INPUT` in its environment and immediately deletes it before its subprocesses. Source archive is a local PATH archive, single managed Release target, credentials pre-supplied, caches disabled, no custom hooks/job config, cloud mutation or auto-submit. The schema's technically unused initiatingUserId holds the already-bound owner account ID; it is not a claimed Expo user/EAS job identity. Tokenless Storefront config is supported by omitting the empty token from the official job's env schema.

All compiler/npm/tool stdout and stderr are privately captured as exact bytes. A child timeout or64MiB aggregate overflow remains failure even if its final status is0, and the process must close before a result is returned. Raw output is included only inside the AEAD output. Public logs contain closed stage/status/count/hash summaries. One approved asset-only HTTPS302 to release-assets.githubusercontent.com is supported without forwarding Authorization; off-host, recursive, HTTP or late-after-deadline forwarding refuses. Immutable ciphertext length/SHA is checked after transfer. No Actions artifact upload, cache, packages, LFS, private runner or billable storage fallback is used. GitHub documents standard public compute as free and Release assets below2GiB with no total-size/bandwidth limit; private-plan counters and Actions storage entitlement remain unknown and unused.

Independent acceptance

The runner and Root separately check the IPA: numeric16/bundle/team/localizations/privacy, exact production API, Hermes magic and signed compiled member/Wallet/scratch/inbox/brightness/cart-consent features, original signed icon checks, all declared signed resource hashes, executable page coverage, special-slot Info/CodeResources/XML/DER hashes, and detached executable CMS with the exact embedded input profile. The original six pure Python algorithm modules are copied unchanged; their old EAS15 receipt guards and brightness EAS-source claim are never invoked. The new independent parser/record has CI16 scope. Compiled markers establish inclusion, not native behavior.

Root reads genuine completed GitHub run/job metadata and downloads only the output cipher. `root-receive.cjs --receive <UUID> <runID>` reconstructs the exact POSIX Mac job on Windows, validates the input-keyed job HMAC, performs its own byte/CMS/keypair audits, writes a private immutable IPA and root-native-audit.json, then binds their actual digests in `lineage.cjs`. CI lineage is `ROOT_IOS16_VALIDATED_GITHUB_CI_LINEAGE`; it never aliases EAS_FINISHED. Root must observe key deletion at completion/failure (`deleteKey` then secret-absence read), retaining a failed cleanup as unresolved. TestFlight, readiness, provider checkout, physical QA and production-ready stay false. Apple account/remote version, source/human install and any future submission require their own genuinely current phase authority.

Validation is offline/synthetic: AEAD tampering/domain separation; real official iOSJob schema; exact Git249; real binary Node capture; timeout0/overflow closure; actual SDK auth instance via synthetic injected class; whole export with real original metadata validators; captured whole runner; Windows POSIX reconstruction; independent receiver/HMAC/time/refusals; pure lineage; in-memory synthetic RSA/P12/CMS checks; independent synthetic Mach-O page/special-slot mutations. None reads real credentials, private proofs, jobs, provider records or device data. Sealing and direct gates save exclusive synthetic outputs; failures are retained rather than promoted.

Primary sources: [public runner pricing](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/runners/github-hosted-runners), [Actions storage billing](https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions), [Release limits](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/releasing-projects-on-github/about-releases), [Release binary200/302](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/releases/assets#get-a-release-asset), [environment policies](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/deploy/configure-and-manage-deployments/manage-environments), [stdin secret placement](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_secret_set), [local EAS builds](https://docs.expo.dev/build-reference/local-builds/), [existing uploaded signing credentials](https://docs.expo.dev/app-signing/apple-developer-program-roles-and-permissions/), [exact image source](https://github.com/actions/runner-images/blob/691bdc2593839b6bd2615aaa9718ca646ec3d4a6/images/macos/macos-26-arm64-Readme.md).
